question: Can an editor initiate a full workspace export?
answer: According to [NL-19:S1], only administrators can initiate a full workspace export. There is no mention of editors having this permission. Therefore, the answer is no, an editor cannot initiate a full workspace export.

sources.title: Atlas User Roles
sources.heading: Permissions
sources.text: Readers can view tickets. Editors can view, create and edit tickets. Administrators can also manage users and settings. Only administrators may initiate a full workspace export.

sources.title: Working from Abroad
sources.heading: Workation
sources.text: Workation is permitted only within the EU for a maximum of ten working days per calendar year. Requests must be submitted at least 15 working days before the start date. Approval is not guaranteed.

sources.title: Remote Work Policy
sources.heading: Workspace
sources.text: Screens must be protected from viewing by third parties. Access to internal systems from outside company locations requires the company VPN. Working from another country is also subject to document NL-07.

sources.title: Atlas User Roles
sources.heading: Assignment
sources.text: The workspace administrator assigns new roles. Employees also need the process in document NL-04 to access the internal company instance. Product roles do not replace internal approval.

sources.title: Working from Abroad
sources.heading: Approvals
sources.text: Both the manager and People Operations must give written approval before travel. Working from abroad is not permitted without both approvals. Document NL-06 alone does not constitute workation approval.
